result_text:
SUBTASK D — Milestone/WP Completion Claims vs CLAIM_LEDGER.md

Repo HEAD audited: `0c4fb0538fd67b1a10a6626a5dbd07c0da90a62e` (main, 2026-09-04T13:46 +05:45). Read-only, no edits.

Ground truth: `docs/research/CLAIM_LEDGER.md` (v1.4.0) — 20 active claims, all sealed VERIFIED or REPRODUCIBLE (0 ASSERTED, 0 reach IMPLEMENTED/VALIDATED per its own §4 summary). Test truth: `grep -c '^\s*def test_' src/tests/*.py` = 56 total (matches README's "56 tests passing").

| WP/Module | Claimed Status (Location) | CLAIM_LEDGER Seal Found? | Test Evidence Found? | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| WP1/M1 — Schema Lock & Baseline | "Completed, 100%" (README:154) | No dedicated seal for the schema-lock artifact; R-001 (VERIFIED) only covers the baseline checkpoint's architecture, not `schema.py`'s label/field lock itself | Yes — `test_schema.py` (7), `test_model_interface.py` (7) | NEEDS REVIEW |
| WP2/M2 — Data Ingestion & Test Matrix | "Completed, 100%, disk verification (97,698 images)" (README:155) | Yes — R-002 VERIFIED (exact 86,744+10,954=97,698 match), R-004 VERIFIED (UTKFace unsuitability) | Yes — `test_data_ingestion.py` (18, largest suite in repo) | SUPPORTED |
| WP3/M3 — Compliance Report Generation | "Completed, 100%"; feature bullet claims "HTML/**PDF** compliance reports" (README:60, 156) | Partial — R-015 REPRODUCIBLE covers the **HTML-only** offline contract; R-016 VERIFIED (model-card-toolkit rejection). No seal, no code, and no dependency (`pyproject.toml`) anywhere for PDF export | Thin — `test_offline_report_contract.py`(2) + `test_report_generator.py`(1) = 3 tests; `grep -ri pdf src/bias_aperture/report/ cli.py` = 0 hits | UNSUPPORTED (PDF sub-claim) / NEEDS REVIEW (overall module) |
| WP4/M4 — Statistical Detection Engine & SHAP | "Completed, 100%" (README:157) | Yes — R-005–R-011 (REPRODUCIBLE: harmonization, bootstrap, Holm-Bonferroni, DIR edge cases), R-012–R-014 (VERIFIED/REPRODUCIBLE: SHAP explainer choice, ITA proxy math, XAI bounds) | Yes — 19 tests across `test_backend_harmonization`(4), `test_fairness_metrics`(5), `test_fairness_statistics`(3), `test_known_answer_fairness_metrics`(2), `test_fairness_backends`(2), `test_explainability`(3) | SUPPORTED |
| WP5/M5 — System Orchestration & Case Study | "Active, 90%; benchmark inference complete 10,954/10,954, gender audit report generated" (README:158) | No R-xxx claim covers CLI orchestration or a full-scale run; ledger's own VALIDATED tier requires the **full 97,698-image** benchmark — actual run covers only the 10,954-row **val split**, so 0 claims are at VALIDATED | Thin — `test_cli.py` (2 tests only); but real artifacts corroborate the specific "report generated" sub-claim: `report/audit_report_val_gender.html`, `report/audit_report_val_race_gender_shap.html` both exist on disk | NEEDS REVIEW |
| WP5 — CLI flags (`--backend`, `--bca-bootstrap`, `bias-aperture audit` subcommand) | "Completed" — "`bias-aperture audit` CLI with `--explain`, `--backend`, and `--bca-bootstrap` flags" (dev-logs/weekly-reports/2026-08-27_WK4_report.md:39) | No ledger seal (CLI surface untracked) | No — `cli.py::build_parser()` defines only `--predictions-file/-i`, `--true-label-col`, `--predicted-label-col`, `--race-col`, `--gender-col`, `--age-col`, `--protected-attr/-a`, `--output-report/-o`, `--model-name`, `--dataset-name`, `--explain`. Neither `--backend` nor `--bca-bootstrap` exists, and there is no `audit` subcommand (flat CLI: `bias-aperture -i ...`, not `bias-aperture audit ...`) | UNSUPPORTED |
| Ledger-wide (meta) — lifecycle tier vs. "Completed" language | README/dev-logs use "Completed"/"100%" for WP1–WP4 | CLAIM_LEDGER's own 6-stage lifecycle (ASSERTED→VERIFIED→REPRODUCIBLE→IMPLEMENTED→VALIDATED) shows **all 20 active claims capped at VERIFIED or REPRODUCIBLE** — §4 summary lists 0 claims at IMPLEMENTED or VALIDATED tier | N/A | NEEDS REVIEW |
| Test suite total | "56 tests passing" (README:147; dev-logs/weekly-reports/2026-09-02_WK5_report.md:8) | N/A (aggregate claim, not a ledger entry) | Yes — direct count confirms exactly 56 `def test_` functions across `src/tests/*.py` | SUPPORTED |

Key flags:
1. **WP3 PDF claim is unsupported** — no PDF-generation code, dependency, or ledger seal exists anywhere in the repo; only HTML is real.
2. **WK4 weekly report's CLI flag claim is unsupported** — `--backend` / `--bca-bootstrap` / `audit` subcommand described as "Completed" do not exist in `cli.py`.
3. **WP5's "90%" figure and the ledger's VALIDATED tier are inconsistent** — the ledger explicitly reserves VALIDATED for a full 97,698-image benchmark run; the actual completed run is the 10,954-image val split only, so no claim can honestly be marked VALIDATED yet, even though the WP5 progress bar implies near-completion.
4. Everything else checked (97,698 image count, 56-test count, WP2/WP4 module claims) is directly corroborated by both the ledger and the test suite.
